If the support of $ x $ is contained in $ S $ and $ f $ is injective on $ S $, then for every $ a \in S $, the value of the domain-mapped function $ \mathrm{mapDomain}\, f\, x $ at $ f(a) $ equals $ x(a) $. items.type:

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {τ : Type u_2} {R : Type u_4} [inst : CommSemiring R] (f : σ → τ) (φ : MvPolynomial σ R) (d : τ →₀ ℕ),
  MvPolynomial.coeff d ((MvPolynomial.rename f) φ) ≠ 0 → ∃ u, Finsupp.mapDomain f u = d ∧ MvPolynomial.coeff u φ ≠ 0

request.query: Evaluating a multivariate polynomial at powers of X is injective if exponent weights are injective on support

items.type:

  Function.Injective ⇑f → Function.Injective ⇑(MvPolynomial.map f)

items.name: PowerSeries.X_pow_mul_injective
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] {k : ℕ}, Function.Injective fun x => PowerSeries.X ^ k * x

items.name: MvPolynomial.expand_injective
items.type: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_3} [inst : CommSemiring R] {n : ℕ}, 0 < n → Function.Injective ⇑(MvPolynomial.expand n)

items.name: MvPolynomial.X_inj
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] [Nontrivial R] (m n : σ),
  MvPolynomial.X m = MvPolynomial.X n ↔ m = n

items.name: MvPolynomial.map_injective_iff
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {S₁ : Type v} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : CommSemiring S₁] (f : R →+* S₁),
  Function.Injective ⇑(MvPolynomial.map f) ↔ Function.Injective ⇑f

request.query: mapDomain is injective on finitely supported functions with support contained in set where the function is injective

items.name: Finsupp.mapDomain_injOn
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {M : Type u_5} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] (S : Set α) {f : α → β},
  Set.InjOn f S → Set.InjOn (Finsupp.mapDomain f) {w | ↑w.support ⊆ S}

items.name: Finsupp.mapDomain_injective
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {M : Type u_5} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] {f : α → β},
  Function.Injective f → Function.Injective (Finsupp.mapDomain f)

items.name: Finsupp.mapDomainEmbedding
items.type: {α : Type u_12} → {β : Type u_13} → (α ↪ β) → (α →₀ ℕ) ↪ β →₀ ℕ

items.name: Finsupp.mapDomain_apply'
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {M : Type u_5} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] (S : Set α) {f : α → β} (x : α →₀ M),
  ↑x.support ⊆ S → Set.InjOn f S → ∀ {a : α}, a ∈ S → (Finsupp.mapDomain f x) (f a) = x a
